from collections import defaultdict
def analyze(p):
    g=G[f'Demo pair {p} input']; o=G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    scc=[c for c in range(W) if all(g[r][c]==8 for r in range(H))]
    srr=[r for r in range(H) if all(x==8 for x in g[r])]
    def bands(seps,n):
        bs=[];prev=-1
        for e in seps+[n]: bs.append((prev+1,e-1)); prev=e
        return bs
    cb=bands(scc,W); rb=bands(srr,H)
    marks=defaultdict(set); fills=defaultdict(set)
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            v=g[r][c]
            if v not in (0,8):
                bi=next(i for i,b in enumerate(rb) if b[0]<=r<=b[1])
                bj=next(j for j,b in enumerate(cb) if b[0]<=c<=b[1])
                marks[v].add((bi,bj))
            v2=o[r][c]
            if v2 not in (0,8):
                bi2=next(i for i,b in enumerate(rb) if b[0]<=r<=b[1])
                bj2=next(j for j,b in enumerate(cb) if b[0]<=c<=b[1])
                fills[v2].add((bi2,bj2))
    return g,o,scc,srr,cb,rb,marks,fills
for p in (1,2,3):
    g,o,scc,srr,cb,rb,mks,fll=analyze(p)
    print('=== pair',p, 'H',len(g),'W',len(g[0]))
    for v in sorted(mks):
        ps=mks[v]
        rs0=sorted({b[0] for b in ps}); cs0=sorted({b[1] for b in ps})
        print(' color',v,'in rowbands',rs0,'colbands',cs0)
        print('   out:',sorted(fll[v]))

import json
from collections import defaultdict
def f(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    srr=[r for r in range(H) if all(x==8 for x in I[r])]
    scc=[c for c in range(W) if all(I[r][c]==8 for r in range(H))]
    rb=[(a,b) for a,b in zip([-1]+srr,srr+[H])]
    cb=[(a,b) for a,b in zip([-1]+scc,scc+[W])]
    marks=defaultdict(list)
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            v=I[r][c]
            if v not in (0,8):
                bi=next(i for i,(x,y) in enumerate(rb) if b[0]<=r<=b[1])
                bj=next(j for j,(x,y) in enumerate(cb) if x<=c<=y)
                marks[v].append((bi,bj,r,c))
    cells={}  # (r,c)->set of colors
    for v,ps in marks.items():
        rs={p[2] for p in ps}; cs={p[3] for p in ps}
        if len(rs)>1:                       # vertical
            rmin=min(p[2] for p in ps); rmax=max(p[2] for p in ps)
            cbins=[bj for _,bj,_,_ in ps]
            cblo,cblhi=min(bins),max(bins)
            for bi,bj_,r0,c0 in ps:
                lo,hi=cb[bj_][0],cb[bj_][1]
                for r in range(rmin,rmax+1):
                    if r in srr: continue
                    for c in range(lo,hi+1):
                        cells.setdefault((r,c),set()).add(v)
        else:                                # horizontal
            cmin=min(p[3] for p in ps); cmax=max(p[3] for p in ps)
            rbins=[bi for bi,_,_,_ in ps]
            for bi_,r0,c0,_ in ps:
                lo,hi=rb[bi_][0],rb[bi_][1]
                for r in range(lo,hi+1):
                    if r in srr: continue
                    for c in range(cmin,cmax+1):
                        cells.setdefault((r,c),set()).add(v)
    return [[6 if len(cells[(r,c)])>1 else list(cells[(r,c)])[0] if (r,c) in cells else 0 for c in range(W)] for r in range(H)]
for p in (1,2,3):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {p} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    o=f(gi)
    print('pair',p,'match:',o==go)
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))

import json
def f(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    srr=[r for r in range(H) if all(x==8 for x in I[r])]
    scc=[c for c in range(W) if all(I[r][c]==8 for r in range(H))]
    rb=[(a,b) for a,b in zip([-1]+srr,srr+[H])]
    cb=[(a,b) for a,b in zip([-1]+scc,scc+[W])]
    marks=defaultdict(list)
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            v=I[r][c]
            if v not in (0,8):
                bi=next(i for i,(x,y) in enumerate(rb) if x<=r<=y)
                bj=next(j for j,(x,y) in enumerate(cb) if x<=c<=y)
                marks[v].append((bi,bj,r,c))
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for v,ps in marks.items():
        rs={p[2] for p in ps}; cs={p[3] for p in ps}
        if len(rs)>1:                        # vertical: marker col-band fixed, all non-sep rows
            rmin=min(p[2] for p in ps); rmax=max(p[2] for p in ps)
            bcols=sorted({p[1] for p in ps})
            bands=[cb[j] for j in bcols]
            for _,bj_,r0,c0 in ps:
                lo,hi=cb[bj_][0],cb[bj_][1]
                for r in range(0,H):
                    if r in srr: continue
                    for c in range(lo,hi+1):
                        out[r][c]=v
        else:                                 # horizontal: marker row-band fixed, all non-sep cols
            cmin=min(p[3] for p in ps); cmax=max(p[3] for p in ps)
            brws=sorted({p[0] for p in ps})
            bands=[rb[j] for j in brws]
            for bi_,_,r0,c0 in ps:
                lo,hi=rb[bi_][0],rb[bi_][1]
                for c in range(0,W):
                    if c in scc: continue
                    for r in range(lo,hi+1):
                        if out[r][c]!=0 and out[r][c]!=v: out[r][c]=6
                        else: out[r][c]=v
    return out
for p in (1,2,3):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {p} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    o=f(gi)
    print('pair',p,'match:',o==go)
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))
